messages:
emily: Heads up — opening a docs PR to add an on-prem 2.1 -> 2.2 migration guide. Main things to cover: KMS provider config changes, HSM/PKCS#11 slot mapping, new ports for the artifact service, and an offline preflight check for air-gapped customers.
tom: Great. For KMS changes can you include the new `kms.provider: 'pkcs11'` example and a note about tokenLabel vs pinFile? We saw confusion in support.
emily: Yes. I'll include a short example and call out both tokenLabel and pinFile. Also planning to add a sample systemd unit for pin-file permissions.
nina: Also add a small preflight script customers can run pre-upgrade to validate ports and DNS. Something like `redwood-preflight.sh` that checks 8443, 9000 (artifact), and the PKCS11 socket.
luke: Remember the artifact service port changed in 2.2 to 9000 from 8088 — add a migration note and a sample iptables/nft rule to allow it in air-gapped installs.
emily: Draft snippet for pkcs11 config and pin-file unit below. Will trim if too long.

```
# example config.yaml
kms:
  provider: "pkcs11"
  pkcs11:
    libraryPath: "/usr/lib/libpkcs11.so"
    tokenLabel: "redwood-hsm"
    slot: 0
    pinFile: "/etc/redwood/pin.txt"
```

```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-pinfile-perms.service
[Unit]
Description=Ensure pin file perms
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/chmod 600 /etc/redwood/pin.txt
ExecStart=/bin/chown root:root /etc/redwood/pin.txt
```

emily: I'll also add a short FAQ: "How do I map multiple keys to slots?" explaining slot numbers are HSM-specific and showing `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` example.
tom: Good. Add note: do NOT commit pin.txt into repo, and show an example of a Kubernetes secret manifest for private deployments.
nina: Preflight script suggestion: check ports, check PKCS11 library loads, and verify CA bundle path. Minimal script snippet: 
```
# redwood-preflight.sh
nc -zv 127.0.0.1 8443 || echo "control plane unreachable"
nc -zv 127.0.0.1 9000 || echo "artifact server unreachable"
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --list-slots || echo "HSM not reachable"
```
luke: CI note: if you add images under docs/assets/ please ensure we run the link-checker and the airgap packager picks them up. ops-bot will fail builds if assets missing.
ops-bot: Reminder: docs link check scheduled. Add `docs/assets/` upload steps to the PR description if you include new files.
emily: Will do. One more technical question: do we want a short migration subsection about KV cache compatibility? In 2.2 we changed the cache prefix format, but we also ship a migration tool. I can add instructions: stop services, run `redwood-kv-migrate --from-prefix v1 --to-prefix v2`, then restart.
tom: Yes include that. Add pre-migration backup step and example S3/airgap tar of the kv dir.
nina: Also add troubleshooting bullets: if upgrade fails mid-migrate, rollback steps (restore backup tar, restart 2.1 services). Keep it concise.
elmiy: (typo) — emily: pushing draft in 15m. tagging @tom and @nina for reviews.
luke: Ping me once PR is open so I can add CI labels and a notes-to-release section.
emily: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4256 — includes pkcs11 examples, preflight script, port matrix, kv-migrate example, and nftables snippet.
tom: Reviewing now, will comment on wording re: tokenLabel vs slot numbering.
nina: Left a minor suggestion to include `set -euo pipefail` in the script and to avoid piping sensitive output.
luke: Added `docs/needs-ci` label.
ops-bot: PR size accepted. Link-checker queued.
emily: Thanks all — will address comments and merge once CI green.
